turns.question: At which hour of the day did the most checkout events happen between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many were there in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no hour-of-day breakdown or hourly checkout metric, so I cannot say which hour had the most checkouts. The closest metrics are checkout_sessions (site sessions with a checkout, by day) and customer_actions (filterable to the checkout action type, by day), but neither goes below the day.
